title: A Sampling Lovász Local Lemma for Large Domain Sizes
authors: Chunyang Wang (Nanjing University, China), Yitong Yin (Nanjing University, China)
abstract: We present polynomial-time algorithms for approximate counting and sampling solutions to constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs) with atomic constraints within the local lemma regime: $$pD^{2+o_q(1)}\lesssim 1$$ for approximate counting and sampling solutions to atomic CSPs [Bezáková et al, SICOMP '19; Galanis, Guo, Wang, TOCT '22], thus establishing an almost tight sampling Lovász local lemma for large domain sizes.
